_note: Human-curated standard tags for assets the catalog can't tag automatically (games, tools, topic practice — anything with no standard in its config and no unit). The concept-map builder (tools/build-asset-concept-map.mjs) reads `overrides`: map an asset PATH (exactly as in catalog.json) to an array of MCCRS 2025 standard codes from data/ccss-standards.json. These are the ONLY hand-authored tags — the builder never guesses. Add entries here to make a game/tool appear in Resource Finder and Insight Brief for those standards.
